items.description: England's impressive T20 form continues as they thrash Sri Lanka by six wickets in Cardiff to seal the series with a match to spare.

items.title: Brook & Baker shine as England crush Sri Lanka
items.description: Harry Brook hit 114 not out in the first innings set up England with a total of 254 proving to difficult for Sri Lanka to chase leading to a England win by 119 runs after bowling out Sri Lanka.

items.title: 'What an innings' - Brook hits century against Sri Lanka
items.description: Watch the best of Harry Brook's sensational century against Sri Lanka from just 42 balls, the joint-second fastest hundred by an Englishman in a T20I.

items.title: Root and Cox to the rescue as England beat Pakistan in third Test
items.description: Captain Joe Root and Jordan Cox help England fight back from an early scare as the hosts recover from 2-2, to successfully chase down 130 and wrap up an eight-wicket win and a 3-0 series clean sweep against Pakistan at Edgbaston.

items.title: 'Celebrations cut short!' - no-ball saves Root after being bowled
items.description: England captain Joe Root gets a huge let-off after being bowled for 23 by Mohammed Ali, but the dismissal is overturned after the delivery was a no-ball, with England 35-2, chasing 130 to win the third and final Test at Edgbaston.

items.title: Fleming on England discipline, Stokes, late arrival and coaching styles
items.description: Read what England's new Test coach Stephen Fleming had to say about Bazball, Ben Stokes, the team's discipline issues and his own philosophy.

items.title: 'Beat the Aussies' - new England coach Fleming's key aim
items.description: New Test coach Stephen Fleming says he shares English cricket’s “obsession” with the Ashes and arrives with the goal to “beat the Aussies”.

items.title: 'One of the worst adverts for county game' - Lehmann
